reply.text:
Gym fees add up, and I'd rather you keep training than keep paying for something that isn't earning its spot. A lot of good training happens with very little: a pair of adjustable dumbbells, a pull-up bar and some bands at home can carry you a long way, and bodyweight work and outdoor runs cost nothing.

If you want to go that route, tell me what you have at home and how many days you can train, and I'll have the app build a block around it. If you're keeping the gym for now, I can make sure you're getting full value from every session.
